title: A device management method based on edge device contribution in federated learning

pse.problem: High energy consumption during local model training on mobile terminals in federal learning due to irregular data sets, varying contribution degrees of edge devices, and dependence on test data sets.
pse.solution_function: Optimizes local model training power consumption by iteratively adjusting CPU working frequency and training precision at user equipment end, and minimizing maximum time delay during uploading model parameters to distribute power effectively.
pse.solution_structure: Cell-FreemMIMO network, user equipment with CPU.
pse.solution_implementation: Iterative adjustment of CPU working frequency and local model training precision, power distribution during model parameter uploading based on minimizing maximum time delay.
pse.effect: Saves energy consumption by optimizing local model training power consumption and effectively distributing power.
